goal.en: Host a client at a business dinner, from ordering to goodbye.
goal.zh: 在商務晚宴上招待客戶，從點菜到道別都得體。

background: private dining room of an upscale seafood restaurant, round table with white cloth and a glass lazy susan, warm pendant lights, large window over a night harbor, evening

intro.en: To celebrate the new contract, Ms. Wong and you take Mr. Becker to dinner before his flight home tomorrow.
intro.zh: 為了慶祝新合約，王經理和你在貝克先生明天搭機回國前，請他吃晚餐。

intro.en: Kai, you know this place well. Why don't you help Mr. Becker with the menu?
intro.zh: 凱，你對這家店很熟。要不要幫貝克先生看看菜單？

lines.en: Everything looks good, and there's so much to choose from. What would you recommend?
lines.zh: 每道菜看起來都很好，選擇好多。你會推薦什麼？

choices.en: The grilled sea bass is excellent here. Would you like to share a few starters too?
choices.zh: 這裡的烤鱸魚非常好吃。您想不想也一起分享幾道前菜？
choices.tip: 先推薦招牌菜，再用 Would you like to... 詢問對方意願，不替客人做主。

choices.en: Don't worry, I'll just order for everyone. Ten dishes to share, like we do back home.
choices.zh: 別擔心，我幫大家點就好。點十道菜一起分，就像我們家鄉那樣。

lines.en: Ten dishes? For three people? I was rather hoping to choose my own meal.
lines.zh: 十道菜？三個人吃？我其實比較希望自己點自己的餐。

story.en: The lazy susan spins with enough food for a wedding. Mr. Becker politely eats rice and wonders what he would have chosen.
story.zh: 轉盤上的菜多到可以辦喜酒。貝克先生客氣地吃著白飯，心裡想著自己原本會點什麼。

fail.why: 在台灣常由主人點一桌菜大家分，但許多西方客人習慣自己點主菜。先推薦，再讓對方選：The grilled sea bass is excellent here. Would you like to share a few starters too?。

choices.en: I recommend you to try the sea bass. It is very fresh and very delicious.
choices.zh: 我推薦你試試鱸魚。非常新鮮，非常好吃。

lines.en: Recommend me to... ah, you mean I should try it. Very, very good, then.
lines.zh: 推薦我去……啊，你是說我應該試試看。那就是非常、非常好囉。

story.en: Mr. Becker orders the sea bass. Your recommendation works, but it sounds more like a school essay than a confident host.
story.zh: 貝克先生點了鱸魚。你的推薦有效，但聽起來比較像作文，而不是從容的主人。

fail.why: recommend 後面不接「人 + to V」，要說 I recommend you try the sea bass.；一直重複 very 也顯得單調。更自然的說法：The grilled sea bass is excellent here.。

lines.en: The drinks arrive, and everyone raises a glass.
lines.zh: 飲料送上來了，大家都舉起了杯子。

lines.en: Kai, why don't you say a few words for our guest?
lines.zh: 凱，要不要為我們的貴賓說幾句話？

choices.en: I'd like to propose a toast to Mr. Becker, and to a long partnership. Cheers!
choices.zh: 我想敬貝克先生一杯，也敬我們長久的合作。乾杯！
choices.tip: 正式敬酒用 I'd like to propose a toast to...，簡短真誠，最後說 Cheers!。

choices.en: To Mr. Becker! Bottoms up, everyone. If you don't finish your glass, you don't give me face!
choices.zh: 敬貝克先生！大家乾杯。誰不喝完，就是不給我面子！

lines.en: I'd rather not finish it in one go. I have an early flight tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我不太想一口喝完。我明天一早要搭飛機。

story.en: Mr. Becker takes a polite sip and sets the glass far away from you. Ms. Wong quickly changes the subject.
story.zh: 貝克先生禮貌地啜了一口，就把杯子放得離你遠遠的。王經理趕緊轉移話題。

fail.why: 勸酒、要求乾杯在許多文化中會讓人不舒服，在商務場合更是失禮。敬酒只要舉杯說祝福：I'd like to propose a toast to Mr. Becker. Cheers!。

choices.en: Everyone, let's dry the cup together! For our friendship and our cooperation!
choices.zh: 各位，我們一起乾杯！為了我們的友誼和合作！

lines.en: Dry the cup? Should I ask the waiter for a towel?
lines.zh: 把杯子擦乾？我該跟服務生要條毛巾嗎？

story.en: Mr. Becker looks around for a napkin. The toast turns into a short lesson on drinking words.
story.zh: 貝克先生四處找餐巾。一場敬酒變成了喝酒用語的小課堂。

fail.why: 「乾杯」直譯成 dry the cup，英文母語者聽不懂。英文說 Cheers!，正式敬酒說 I'd like to propose a toast to...。

lines.en: Ms. Wong tells me you moved here from abroad. What do you miss most about home?
lines.zh: 王經理說你是從國外搬來的。你最想念家鄉的什麼？

choices.en: Honestly, the night markets and the street food. Have you ever been to one?
choices.zh: 老實說，是夜市和小吃。您去過夜市嗎？
choices.tip: 回答私人話題時簡短分享，再反問對方，讓對話有來有往。

choices.en: I miss my mother cooking the most. Her beef noodle is the best of the world.
choices.zh: 我最想念我媽媽煮的菜。她的牛肉麵是世界上最好吃的。

lines.en: Your mother... is cooking? Ah, your mother's cooking. Of the world?
lines.zh: 你媽媽……正在煮飯？啊，是你媽媽煮的菜。世界的？

story.en: It is a lovely memory, but Mr. Becker spends most of it decoding the sentence. The beef noodles never quite reach him.
story.zh: 這是很溫馨的回憶，但貝克先生大半時間都在解讀句子。牛肉麵的美味始終沒傳達到。

fail.why: 所有格要加 's：my mother's cooking；「世界上最好的」是 the best in the world，不是 of the world。牛肉麵可以說 beef noodle soup。

choices.en: Let's not talk about that. Can we confirm the delivery schedule for next month instead?
choices.zh: 我們別聊這個了。可以改來確認下個月的出貨時程嗎？

lines.en: I was only trying to get to know you. But fine, the schedule.
lines.zh: 我只是想多認識你一點。不過好吧，談時程。

story.en: The rest of the dinner feels like a second meeting. Mr. Becker checks his watch twice before dessert.
story.zh: 剩下的晚餐感覺像第二場會議。甜點上桌前，貝克先生看了兩次手錶。

fail.why: 商務晚餐的閒聊是建立關係的機會，對方問私人話題時硬拉回公事，會顯得冷淡。簡單分享再反問：Honestly, the night markets. Have you ever been to one?。

lines.en: After dessert, the waiter brings the bill. Mr. Becker reaches for it first.
lines.zh: 甜點吃完後，服務生送來帳單。貝克先生先伸手去拿。

lines.en: Please, let me get this. You've both been wonderful hosts.
lines.zh: 請讓我來付吧。你們兩位都是很棒的主人。

choices.en: That's very kind, but you're our guest tonight. It's our pleasure.
choices.zh: 您真客氣，但今晚您是我們的客人。這是我們的榮幸。
choices.tip: 主人請客時說 You're our guest tonight.，溫和而堅定地婉拒對方買單。

choices.en: No, no, no! Give it to me! I insist, I insist! You can't pay, absolutely not!
choices.zh: 不不不！給我！我堅持，我堅持！您不能付，絕對不行！

lines.en: All right, all right! There's no need to wrestle me for it.
lines.zh: 好啦好啦！不需要跟我搶成這樣。

story.en: You win the bill, and the next table wins a free show. Ms. Wong pretends to check her phone.
story.zh: 你搶到了帳單，隔壁桌則免費看了一場表演。王經理假裝在看手機。

fail.why: 在台灣搶著買單是禮貌，但激烈拉扯在許多文化中會讓人尷尬。溫和堅定就好：That's very kind, but you're our guest tonight.。

choices.en: No, no. This meal I invite you. Next time you can invite me back.
choices.zh: 不不，這餐我請你。下次你可以再請我。

lines.en: You invite me... to this meal? But I'm already here.
lines.zh: 你邀請我……來吃這頓飯？可是我已經在這裡了。

story.en: Mr. Becker thanks you for the invitation, again. Nobody is quite sure who is paying until Ms. Wong signs the bill.
story.zh: 貝克先生又一次感謝你的邀請。直到王經理簽了帳單，大家才確定是誰付錢。

fail.why: 「這餐我請」不能直譯成 I invite you，invite 是邀請別人參加活動。英文說 This one's on us. 或 It's our treat.，也可以說 You're our guest tonight.。

lines.en: Outside the restaurant, a taxi is waiting to take Mr. Becker back to his hotel.
lines.zh: 餐廳外，一輛計程車正等著送貝克先生回飯店。

lines.en: Thank you both for a wonderful evening. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
lines.zh: 謝謝兩位今晚的款待。很高興和你們做生意。

choices.en: The pleasure was ours. Have a safe flight, and we look forward to working together.
choices.zh: 這是我們的榮幸。祝您一路平安，期待我們的合作。
choices.tip: 對方說 It was a pleasure... 時，用 The pleasure was ours. 回應，再加上一句祝福。

choices.en: Wish you have a nice trip back to home, and hope we can cooperate happily.
choices.zh: 祝你回家一路順利，希望我們能合作愉快。

lines.en: Back to home... cooperate happily? Thank you, I think.
lines.zh: 回到家……愉快地合作？謝謝，大概吧。

story.en: Mr. Becker smiles and waves from the taxi. The goodbye is warm, just a little wobbly at the end.
story.zh: 貝克先生在計程車裡微笑揮手。道別很溫馨，只是結尾有點搖晃。

fail.why: wish 後面不接完整子句，要說 I hope you have a safe trip.；home 前面不加 to，說 back home。祝合作愉快可以說 We look forward to working together.。

choices.en: Finally! I'm so tired. Okay, bye-bye, see you next time. I really need to sleep.
choices.zh: 終於！我好累。好，掰掰，下次見。我真的需要睡覺了。

lines.en: Oh. I'm sorry to have kept you out so late.
lines.zh: 噢，抱歉讓你待到這麼晚。

story.en: Mr. Becker gets into the taxi feeling like a burden. A perfect evening ends on a yawn.
story.zh: 貝克先生坐上計程車，覺得自己像個負擔。完美的夜晚以一個哈欠收場。

fail.why: 送客時說自己很累、「終於結束」，會讓對方覺得自己是負擔。把疲憊藏好，好好道別：The pleasure was ours. Have a safe flight.。

lines.en: I'll be back in spring for the next order. Save me a seat at this table.
lines.zh: 春天我會再來談下一筆訂單。這張桌子幫我留個位子。

lines.en: Well done tonight, Kai. Contracts are signed in meetings, but partnerships begin at dinner.
lines.zh: 今晚表現得很好，凱。合約是在會議上簽的，但合作關係是從晚餐開始的。

story.en: Mr. Becker sends a thank-you email from the airport. A week later, Alpenhaus orders lighting for three more hotels.
story.zh: 貝克先生在機場寄來感謝信。一週後，阿爾彭豪斯飯店集團又為另外三家飯店下了照明訂單。

notes.en: I'd like to propose a toast to...
notes.explain: 正式敬酒的開頭，後面接人或事。說完舉杯說 Cheers!，不需要要求對方喝完。

example.en: I'd like to propose a toast to our new partners. Cheers!
example.zh: 我想敬我們的新夥伴一杯。乾杯！

notes.en: Would you like to share a few starters?
notes.zh: 要不要一起分幾道前菜？
notes.explain: 許多西方客人習慣自己點主菜，主人可以推薦，但不要替所有人點一整桌。想分享時，前菜是最自然的選擇。

example.en: The crab cakes are great. Would you like to share a few starters?
example.zh: 蟹肉餅很好吃。要不要一起分幾道前菜？

notes.explain: 主人請客時婉拒對方買單的說法，溫和而堅定。也可以說 This one's on us. 或 It's our treat.。

example.en: Please, put your wallet away. You're our guest tonight.
example.zh: 請把錢包收起來，今晚您是我們的客人。

notes.explain: 「乾杯」不是 dry the cup，「我請你」也不是 I invite you（invite 是邀請別人參加活動）。喝酒說 Cheers!，請客說 It's our treat.。

example.en: Cheers, everyone! And dinner is our treat tonight.
example.zh: 大家乾杯！今晚的晚餐我們請客。

notes.explain: 回應 It was a pleasure... 的禮貌說法。代表公司時可以說 The pleasure was ours.，後面再加一句祝福。

example.en: The pleasure was mine. Have a safe trip home.
example.zh: 這是我的榮幸。祝您回程平安。
